_comment: Single source of truth for each class's strengths, weaknesses, special ability, subclass text (the nodes each subclass locks are in Progression/ClassTrees) and ability scores. Read by the game (class guidebook, class-pick chat message) and used to generate the Player Classes table in README.md: after editing, run ./gradlew generateClassReadme. Write each point as a short phrase without a trailing full stop; the game joins them into sentences. specialOnKey says whether the special is fired with the Power Up key (otherwise it is always active). abilities are the class's ability scores (a permutation of the standard array 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8); saves are its two saving throw proficiencies; skills are its skill proficiencies; expertise lists the skills it has double proficiency in (each must also be in skills). See docs/systems/ability-scores.md. role and secondaryRole are the party roles (TANK, HEALER, DAMAGE, SUPPORT, UTILITY); roleBlurb and obstacles fill the guidebook's Your role page.

classes.name: Barbarian
cons: Limited vision: fog closes in at about 24 blocks
special: **Rage**: Strength I for 8 seconds, rising to Strength III for 12 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Soak hits up front and smash through what blocks the way
obstacles: **Heavy Boulders**: heave them aside while raging (only you)

subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.title: Berserker Barbarian
subclasses.flavour: Rage without end: every kill feeds the fury.
subclasses.feature: **Frenzy**: while Rage is active, each melee kill adds 2 seconds to it (up to 6 seconds per Rage)

subclasses.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
subclasses.title: Totem Warrior Barbarian
subclasses.flavour: A bear spirit stands with you, shrugging off blows.
subclasses.feature: **Bear Totem Spirit**: while Rage is active you take 15% less damage

classes.name: Bard
special: **Animal Friends**: nearby animals you have charmed with an instrument become companions that follow and fight for you
classes.roleBlurb: Keep the party fighting with songs, inspiration and rest
obstacles: **Singing Doors**: sing them open and skip the tune puzzle (only you)

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.title: Valor Bard
subclasses.flavour: Songs of heroes, sung at the front line.
subclasses.feature: **Combat Inspiration**: players who get your instrument buff also get +2 armor for its 30 seconds

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.title: Lore Bard
subclasses.flavour: A head full of stories, secrets and silver words.
subclasses.feature: **Bardic Lore**: +2 to Persuasion checks, and you identify magic items when you pick them up

classes.name: Cleric
cons: Shorter view distance: fog closes in at about 48 blocks
special: **Sanctuary**: a circle mobs won't target, lasting 6 to 15 seconds by rank. From rank II, party members within 8 to 16 blocks share it and regenerate
classes.roleBlurb: Keep the party alive and turn back the unholy
obstacles: **Desecrated Altars**: consecrate them to stop nearby spawners and heal the party (only you)

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.title: Life Cleric
subclasses.flavour: A healer first, and a scourge of the undead.
subclasses.feature: **Disciple of Life**: Cure Wounds, Sanctuary's party Regeneration and Divine Intervention heal 25% more

subclasses.name: Forge Domain
subclasses.title: Forge Cleric
subclasses.flavour: Blessed hammer, blessed ore, blessed steel.
subclasses.feature: **Blessing of the Forge**: once a day, make one held weapon or worn armor piece +1 until the next day, at an Attunement Table

classes.name: Druid
pros: An extra heart for each tamed animal, up to 5
cons: Gets hungry in the dark (light level 4 or lower)
special: **Wild Shape**: become an animal you have killed and unlocked at an Attunement Table for 15 to 30 seconds by rank. Sneak and press the key to choose the form
classes.roleBlurb: Regrow the party's wounds and take whatever shape the moment needs

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.title: Moon Druid
subclasses.flavour: More beast than human, at home in any wild shape.
subclasses.feature: **Primal Strike**: your attacks deal +2 damage in animal form

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.title: Land Druid
subclasses.flavour: Rooted in the land, drawing strength from it.
subclasses.feature: **Natural Recovery**: +1 mana pip every 30 seconds while standing on grass, leaves or moss

classes.name: Fighter
pros: Draws aggro: hostile mobs target a Fighter before other players
cons: No beneficial potions: potions can't be drunk and buffs don't apply, but harmful effects still do
special: **Super Regeneration**: Regeneration V for 4 seconds, up to 10 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Draw the enemy's attention and outlast them
obstacles: **Portcullises**: wedge them open for good (only you)

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.title: Champion Fighter
subclasses.flavour: Raw might and perfect strikes.
subclasses.feature: **Superior Critical**: melee attack rolls crit on 18-20

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.title: Battle Master Fighter
subclasses.flavour: Every block, parry and counter is a lesson.
subclasses.feature: **Combat Superiority**: blocking a melee hit with a shield restores 1 mana pip (at most once every 5 seconds)

classes.name: Monk
cons: Reduced damage: 75% unarmored, and less the more armor you wear
Can only attack with a staff or bare fists
special: **Flurry Rush**: blink between the mob you're looking at and hostiles near it for a rapid chain of hits, then blink back. 3 hits on 1 target, up to 10 hits across 5 targets with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Strike fast and reach places nobody else can
obstacles: **Chasms**: leap them and lower the bridge for everyone (only you)

subclasses.name: Way of the Open Hand
subclasses.title: Open Hand Monk
subclasses.flavour: Fists that topple giants.
subclasses.feature: **Open Hand Technique**: each Flurry Rush hit gives the target Slowness II for 2 seconds and knocks it back a little

subclasses.name: Way of the Drunken Master
subclasses.title: Drunken Master Monk
subclasses.flavour: A sway, a stagger, and the blow misses.
subclasses.feature: **Tipsy Sway**: with no chestplate on, 15% of melee hits miss you, and drinking Ale gives 2 mana pips

classes.name: Paladin
pros: Unaffected by potions, good or bad (ability effects still apply)
cons: Cannot craft (crafting table, stonecutter, smithing table, loom) or brew potions
Very weak in the Nether: half damage and armor, 20% slower
special: **Divine Judgment**: a beam of holy light strikes the mob you look at within 30 blocks, sets it alight and sends out a shockwave. Undead take 50% more damage. Damage, shockwave and extra beams grow with rank
classes.roleBlurb: Shield your allies with your aura and heal them when it counts
obstacles: **Dread Wards**: walk through and shield allies within 6 blocks from the fear (only you)

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.title: Devotion Paladin
subclasses.flavour: Sworn to honour, light and the slaying of the undead.
subclasses.feature: **Purity of Spirit**: you're immune to Wither and Poison, and undead deal you 15% less damage

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest
subclasses.title: Conquest Paladin
subclasses.flavour: Sworn to crush every foe beneath the banner.
subclasses.feature: **Conquering Presence**: Divine Judgment's shockwave frightens hostile mobs for 3 seconds

classes.name: Ranger
pros: Can zoom in with a bow
special: **Arrow Storm**: hold right click to fire arrows without using ammo. Fire rate, arrow speed and duration grow with rank; no zooming while it runs
classes.roleBlurb: Bring down foes from range and spot what others miss
obstacles: **Hidden doors and traps**: spot them without searching (only you)

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.title: Hunter Ranger
subclasses.flavour: Patient, precise, and always on the trail.
subclasses.feature: **Colossus Slayer**: your first arrow hit each second on a target below full health deals +3 damage

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker
subclasses.title: Horizon Walker Ranger
subclasses.flavour: A guardian of the borders between worlds.
subclasses.feature: **Planar Warrior**: in the Nether and the End you deal 20% more damage and have Speed I

classes.name: Rogue
pros: Never needs to eat: food never drains and you never starve, but food doesn't regenerate health either
special: **Vanish**: invisibility for 6 seconds at rank I, up to 15 seconds at rank IV
classes.roleBlurb: Strike from the shadows and open what is locked
obstacles: **Locked chests and doors**: pick them (only you)

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.title: Assassin Rogue
subclasses.flavour: Strike first, from the dark, and once is enough.
subclasses.feature: **Assassinate**: double damage to a mob that isn't targeting you, and your first hit after Vanish ends is a critical

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.title: Thief Rogue
subclasses.flavour: Quick hands, light feet and an eye for treasure.
subclasses.feature: **Fast Hands**: +3 to lockpicking, and you ignore class restrictions when attuning magic items

classes.name: Necromancer
special: **Raise Dead**: 2 undead allies for 10 seconds, up to 5 stronger undead and a Bone Wyvern for 20 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Walk among the dead and raise an army of your own
obstacles: Lead the party past sleeping crypt undead

subclasses.name: Bonecaller
subclasses.title: Bonecaller Necromancer
subclasses.flavour: Master of a tireless skeleton host.
subclasses.feature: **Undying Servants**: your summons last 25% longer

subclasses.name: Plaguebringer
subclasses.title: Plaguebringer Necromancer
subclasses.flavour: Rot and wither in your wake.
subclasses.feature: **Grim Harvest**: killing a mob that has your Wither heals you 2 hearts

classes.name: Warlock
pros: Throws fireballs from an empty hand
cons: Hurt by water and rain: 1 damage every 4 seconds, never below 1 heart
special: **Fire Breath**: hold the key to breathe fire, 8 seconds and 3 blocks at rank I up to 20 seconds and 7 blocks at rank IV
classes.roleBlurb: Blast foes with eldritch fire and curse them for your allies
obstacles: **Fire Curtains**: walk through and douse the brazier (only you)

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.title: Fiend Warlock
subclasses.flavour: A pact sealed in hellfire.
subclasses.feature: **Dark One's Own Luck**: once every 2 minutes, a failed d20 roll of yours is rerolled

subclasses.name: The Great Old One
subclasses.title: Great Old One Warlock
subclasses.flavour: A pact with something vast, from beyond the stars.
subclasses.feature: **Entropic Ward**: once every 60 seconds, a projectile that would hit you misses

classes.name: Wizard
cons: Can't wear armor heavier than iron
special: **Arcane Explosion**: a 12-block blast with Resistance V for 2 seconds, up to 72 blocks and 5 seconds with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Deal huge area damage and unravel magic

subclasses.name: School of Evocation
subclasses.title: Evocation Wizard
subclasses.flavour: Raw elemental power, shaped so it spares your friends.
subclasses.feature: **Sculpt Spells**: your staff blasts, Arcane Explosion and Meteor Swarm don't hurt party members or their pets

subclasses.name: School of Abjuration
subclasses.title: Abjuration Wizard
subclasses.flavour: Wards, shields and the art of staying alive.
subclasses.feature: **Arcane Ward**: every active you fire gives 2 absorption hearts (up to 4) for 60 seconds

classes.name: Artificer
pros: 25% chance for crafted tools, weapons and armor to come out enchanted
cons: Unaffected by potions: can't drink them and is immune to splash, lingering and tipped-arrow effects (ability effects still apply)
special: **Reinforced Armor**: +8 armor and +4 toughness for 30 seconds
classes.roleBlurb: Craft better gear and keep the party's armour strong

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.title: Armorer Artificer
subclasses.flavour: Your armor is your greatest invention.
subclasses.feature: **Power Armor**: Arcane Armor lasts 45 seconds instead of 30 and adds 0.5 knockback resistance

subclasses.name: Battle Smith
subclasses.title: Battle Smith Artificer
subclasses.flavour: A smith of war, with a steel companion at your side.
subclasses.feature: **Battle Ready**: +2 attack damage with any identified magic weapon

classes.name: Blood Hunter
cons: Can't drop swords (they still drop on death)
special: **Blood Control**: take control of the mob you look at, 8 seconds within 15 blocks at 60% success, up to 20 seconds, 30 blocks and 100% with ranks. Strong mobs resist more, a failure costs the mana and a heart, and bosses can't be controlled. Requires the Identity mod
classes.roleBlurb: Hunt by night and turn your enemies' blood against them
obstacles: **Blood Seals**: open them for 2 hearts (anyone else pays 8, and can split it)

subclasses.name: Order of the Profane Soul
subclasses.title: Profane Soul Blood Hunter
subclasses.flavour: Blood curses, honed to a fine edge.
subclasses.feature: **Rite Focus**: Crimson Rite's bleed lasts 2 seconds longer, and Curse of Binding costs 2 mana instead of 3

subclasses.name: Order of the Lycan
subclasses.title: Lycan Blood Hunter
subclasses.flavour: The beast inside, held on a leash.
subclasses.feature: **Stalker's Prowess**: +10% movement speed at night, and Hybrid Transformation lasts 20 seconds instead of 15

classes.name: Alchemist
pros: Can brew potions only the Alchemist knows
Brewing stands are safe: a stand explodes when its brew finishes if the last player to use it wasn't an Alchemist (stands nobody has used, such as hopper-fed ones, are safe)
cons: Cannot enchant (enchanting table or enchanted books on an anvil)
special: **Transmute**: throw your held potion (or an unstable brew) as a lingering cloud with stronger effects, buffing allies and harming mobs. Bigger and longer-lasting with ranks
classes.roleBlurb: Brew clouds that strengthen allies and weaken foes

subclasses.name: Mutagenist
subclasses.title: Mutagenist Alchemist
subclasses.flavour: Every potion changes you a little more.
subclasses.feature: **Mutagen**: drinking any potion also gives Strength I for 10 seconds

subclasses.name: Transmuter
subclasses.title: Transmuter Alchemist
subclasses.flavour: Lead to gold, poison to medicine.
subclasses.feature: **Transmuter's Eye**: Healing potions you drink heal 50% more, and you identify potions when you pick them up
